YOUR FIRST FLIGHT STARTS HERE

Your flight.
One call at a time.

From your first clearance to your final taxi call, LearnATC helps you find the right words.

  1. 01

    Set up your flight

    Enter your airline, flight number, aircraft, and departure stand. Choose your departure and arrival airports from the search results, then select Create radio script.

    Flight numbers can include letters, such as 24AB.
  2. 02

    Listen to the ATIS

    Find the airport’s ATIS using your pilot client. Enter its information letter and QNH, then select the reported departure runway from the dropdown.

    Check the runway in use with ATIS or ATC.
  3. 03

    Follow your script

    Work through each stage of your flight. Record the departure, squawk, altitude, and taxi instructions you receive. Your radio calls update as you enter the details.

    Amber placeholders show details you still need to enter.
  4. 04

    Speak, listen, and tick

    Use the You say boxes to guide your calls. Tick each box after speaking, and follow the controller’s instructions before moving to the next stage.

    If you miss an instruction, ask the controller to say it again.

A little help along the way

Use the settings gear to make script text larger, show ATC examples, or change celebration preferences. Your flight progress stays saved in the current browser tab.

ATC examples are practice lines, not live clearances. Follow your controller and keep your airport charts available.
